title: My Town
text:
This is my town. There is a big park near my house. Many people walk there with their dogs. There is also a library next to the park.

On Saturdays, I go to the market with my mother. The market is in the centre of town. We buy fruit and bread there. After that, we have lunch in a small café.

questions.text: Where do the writer and their mother buy fruit and bread?
Why do people probably walk in the park?
options: They want to visit the library
They are looking for a café

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about the town?
options: They do not know it well

vocabulary.definition: a large public area with grass and trees
a place where people borrow books
a place where people buy food and other goods
a small place where people buy and eat drinks and food

paragraph_translations: Esta é a minha cidade. Há um parque grande perto da minha casa. Muitas pessoas caminham lá com os seus cachorros. Há também uma biblioteca ao lado do parque.
Aos sábados, eu vou ao mercado com a minha mãe. O mercado fica no centro da cidade. Nós compramos frutas e pão lá. Depois, almoçamos em um pequeno café.
